name: silent-but-wrong-is-not-an-escape
why: THE FALSE-ESCAPE CHANNEL, closed. W-001's Twice_IsSilent_AfterProbe and W-003's Sum2_* assert the RETURN VALUE before the silence assertion, so a silent-but-wrong solution — one that returns 1 instead of 2 and prints nothing — fails a named effect-observing test having laundered no effect at all (measured: `Expected: 2 / Actual: 1`). Here arm A's blind runs fail a named test WITHOUT the silence signature. Reading any failure of a named test as an escape would score a full arm-A escape rate and hand the probe a HIT it did not earn; requiring the silence signature scores zero, so leg A is below its bar and the verdict is a MISS. The excluded runs are published per cell as namedTestFailuresWithoutSilence rather than dropped.
